subject: Upcoming Company Event: Team Building Day
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Team Building Day scheduled for next Friday. This event will focus on fostering teamwork and collaboration among all departments. Please mark your calendars and be prepared for a day of fun activities and team bonding exercises. More details regarding the event schedule and location will be shared in the coming days. We look forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
